NorthRoute Down Again?

Sources tell me NorthRoute Carrier is suspended again on their main WH corridor. I'm hearing the delay could be anywhere from 2 days to a week. Personally I think ITM-A1 inventory is way overstated - more like 300 units not the 380 they claim. Take this with a grain of salt.
